node.doctext:
haukex Can you please write the code?

I already did, if you click the link I provided twice. [doc://File::Find] examples are easy to find too. I'm also happy to write code if you show your efforts (=code) - show what you tried, explain how it doesn't work, if you provide a [id://1177642|SSCCE], and post a question according to [id://174051] But sending me two private messages with essentially the same as your post here is not going to motivate me, quite the opposite. As [Corion] already [id://11149121|said], we're happy to help you learn, but this is not a code wrtiting service.
